$comment: PROPOSAL ONLY. This file has no force until Human/Ops returns an authoritative decision receipt for ODP-PLAN-OSS-LEGAL-POLICY-001. status is 'proposed' and MUST NOT be edited to 'approved' by any AI agent or repository author -- approval is carried by an external receipt, not by this file.

prepared_from.$comment: Inventory taken from the installed trees, not from a template. npm from node_modules package.json license fields; python from uv.lock names intersected with installed distribution metadata, which excludes Ubuntu system packages.

allow.$comment: Permissive licenses observed in the tree. Counts are npm unless noted.

licenses.obligation: NOTICE file retention; state changes on modification.

allow_with_obligations.$comment: Weak/file-level copyleft. Proposed allowed because none of these are modified or statically linked here, but each carries a standing obligation.

observed.note: Dual-licensed under MPL-2.0 AND (Apache-2.0 OR MIT)

licenses.obligation: File-level copyleft. If an MPL-2.0 source file is modified, that file's source must be made available under MPL-2.0. Combining with proprietary code in a larger work is permitted.
licenses.current_state: No MPL-2.0 source file is modified in this repository. Consumption is unmodified upstream artifacts only.

licenses.obligation: Attribution required for the data set. This is a data licence, not a code licence.

review_required.$comment: These are the decisions this policy cannot make for Legal. Each is a real, present case -- not a hypothetical.

cases.why_it_matters: Next.js image optimisation pulls libvips into the production image. This is the classic LGPL dynamic-linking case: sharp loads libvips as a prebuilt shared library and does not modify it.
cases.decision_needed: Allow outright / allow subject to conditions (linking method, NOTICE, source offer) / review per release / prohibit.
cases.if_prohibited: Next.js image optimisation must be disabled or replaced; this is not a drop-in removal.

cases.why_it_matters: The PostgreSQL driver used by dlt. Upstream states LGPL-3 plus an exception permitting linking; the exception text is what makes this workable and should be read rather than assumed.
cases.decision_needed: Confirm the upstream exception is acceptable, or require a differently licensed driver.

cases.why_it_matters: Direct production PostgreSQL driver and connection pool. Unlike psycopg2 (which carries an explicit linking exception), psycopg 3.x is licensed under LGPL-3.0-only without linking exceptions. As an LGPL-3.0 library loaded dynamically in production Python runtime, Legal must evaluate whether dynamic linking / C extension usage conforms to the organization's LGPL-3.0 policy (including user relinking and reverse engineering considerations).
cases.decision_needed: Allow subject to conditions (unmodified upstream binary distribution, dynamic linking, NOTICE disclosure, source code offer) / replace with an alternatively licensed driver (such as asyncpg under Apache-2.0) / prohibit.
cases.if_prohibited: Database access layer must be migrated to an alternative PostgreSQL driver.

cases.why_it_matters: Compiled C/C++ core extensions for pymoo (multi-objective optimization library used in production). Licensed under LGPL-2.1-or-later and dynamically imported by pymoo as a compiled extension module.
cases.decision_needed: Allow subject to conditions (dynamic linking / shared library loading, unmodified upstream distribution, NOTICE retention) / replace multi-objective optimization dependency / prohibit.
cases.if_prohibited: Multi-objective optimization algorithms relying on pymoo/moocore must be replaced.

cases.why_it_matters: These 8 are our own workspace packages with no license field. They are not third-party risk, but a scanner cannot tell that apart from a genuinely unlicensed dependency.
cases.decision_needed: Declare a license (or an explicit UNLICENSED marker) on first-party workspace packages so the gate can distinguish first-party from unknown-third-party.

deny.$comment: None of these were found in either tree at the time of preparation. The list is prospective. Note: Commons Clause is a license condition/rider rather than a standalone SPDX identifier.

compound_expressions.$comment: SPDX compound expression resolution rules for evaluation against SBOM component licenses.

compound_expressions.or_operator: allowed if at least one disjunct is in allow or allow_with_obligations (subject to that disjunct's obligations)
compound_expressions.and_operator: governed by the most restrictive conjunct across deny > review_required > allow_with_obligations > allow

unknown_handling.$comment: PROPRIETARY is not currently observed. If it appears it is review_required.

enforcement.$comment: License gate and CycloneDX SBOM license population implemented under ODP-OSS-LICENSE-GATE-002; policy enforcement evaluates allow/deny/review_required rules and fails closed on unexempted or unknown licenses.
